It integrates with Last.fm (providing details like play count per song) and Apple Music, and is adding a language breakdown of the songs you listen to (e.g., EN 80%, ES 15%, FR 5%).

mentions.name: Listening Facts
mentions.description: This web app visualizes a user's music listening habits as a nutrition facts-style label based on their top tracks. It integrates with Last.fm (providing details like play count per song) and Apple Music, having pivoted from a Spotify-first focus after API access changes. Work is underway on language detection to add a language breakdown (e.g., EN 80%, ES 15%, FR 5%) to the displayed label items.
